events.title: Derelict signal
events.text: Sensors have picked up a navigation beacon in the derelict field. Investigate the field, or continue on your current course. No salvage reward is promised.

events.title: Convoy charter
events.text:
Captain, keep the convoy solvent. The Transport is fitted for cargo: loads board on departure and pay on delivery at another trading port.

Set your course on the Map. Buy fitted ships and change loadouts at shipyards.

events.title: Unidentified contacts
events.text: Small craft are closing fast. They answer no hails, and they are not human. Weapons free.

events.title: Free trader
events.text: A battered independent hauler hails you. "Spare fuel cells, no questions asked. Sixty credits for forty units."

events.title: Drone vanguard
events.text: More of the alien craft, flying in formation this time. They have been waiting along the lane.

events.title: Leviathan Protocol
events.text:
EMERGENCY BROADCAST. A biological fleet has been detected in the neighboring sector. Leviathan Protocol is in effect: all registered flagships are ordered into service.

An alien Warden has seized the Bastion Gate. Clear it. Requisition funds have been transferred.

events.title: Swarm scouts
events.text: A larger pack peels away from the swarm and turns toward the convoy.

events.title: Asteroid corridor
events.text: The lane narrows into a drifting rock field. Something is hiding among the rocks.

events.title: Derelict field
events.text: Gutted freighters, scored by something that was not a weapon. Their holds are still sealed, and a few dormant shapes cling to the hulls.

events.title: Distress call
events.text: A merchant hauler is pinned down by alien craft. Its captain offers to join your fleet if you clear the attackers. If command capacity is full, the crew pays the fitted ship's value instead.

events.title: Pale nebula
events.text: The cloud is laced with organic filaments. Your labs could learn a great deal, if the hulls can take the radiation.

events.title: The Warden
events.text: A vast armored organism sits in the gate, shielded by two pylons. Its lance charges. This is what the Protocol sent you to clear.
